says: Every caller wraps GatewayClient.notify in rpc, which is Effect.fn("runtime.rpc"), so a rejected notify ends a span whose failed exit holds the LedgerError message that lost() fills with what the platform threw, the text the new [secrets] law keeps out of reach's spans.
proof: runtime.ts:292 `export const rpc = Effect.fn("runtime.rpc")`; runtime.ts:777 `rpc(GatewayClient.make(env.CONNECTION.getByName(connection)).notify(client, news))`; platform.ts:53 `lost` sets `message: thrown(cause.cause)`; RepliesTest.ts:107 counts Cause.pretty of a failed exit as span text, and the build's own finding 2026-11-13-reach-opens-a-span-that-keeps-letter-text showed that text as 'LedgerError: Error: BODY'. platform.test.ts:136 tests GatewayClient alone, so the rpc span around it is never captured.
cost: A letter's text a platform rejection carries still reaches an in-memory or exported span on the real call path; the law's title reads as if no span keeps it.
